posts.title: Local, Cloud or Both? What LM Studio Taught Me
posts.description: Patrick explores local AI after buying a modest M6 Mac mini, using LM Studio, Ollama, and models such as Qwen, Gemma, and others. He values customization, privacy, offline work, and model variety, while acknowledging cloud trade-offs and safety risks.
